purpose: Compact event-risk layer for the future dashboard. Show only events that can materially change a currency or pair view; never fill space with a full calendar.

relevance_rules.currency_view: Keep an event only when its category maps to a current macro/CB driver or an explicit invalidate/confirm condition.
relevance_rules.pair_view: Keep an event only when it affects one or both legs and can change the relative macro/CB/rates contrast.
relevance_rules.focus_view: Prioritize events linked to CLEAN/PARTIAL focus pairs or to currencies with macro-transmission disconnects.
